name: crux-growth-skills
description: Growth skills for ecommerce brands by gocrux.io, written by operators who have scaled them. Best with a Crux Growth Brain connected. Four skills: a Black Friday plan on your own data (your targets tested against last year, with day-by-day targets to download), a landing page audit (your weakest pages, or any page from its URL, with prioritised fixes and a test backlog), a performance diagnosis (why a KPI moved between two periods, its main driver and what to do about it) and a monthly performance review (a deck of last month across trading, acquisition, retention and LTV, and order value and product, with recommendations).
